standard.summary: 每行一个。无 preview_groups 时作为指标评估与 XY 的
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。

standard_en.summary: One per line. With no preview_groups they serve as the metric evaluation's and the XY's
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced_en.principle: One per line. Without preview_groups, serves metric evaluation and the XY grid's Y axis. Configure preview groups alongside for cleaner comparisons.
